author: iFixit
description:
Is Apple’s most affordable laptop ever also one of its most repairable? Sounds crazy, but it’s true: We haven’t been as happy about a MacBook since 2012.

It’s not all music to our ears, though. Reviewers claim the speakers don’t measure up to the usual MacBook bar. And you’re stuck with 8GB of RAM, thanks to the limitations of the A18 Pro System on Chip. Can the Neo deliver where Chromebooks fail? Let’s open it up and find out.

In the video, we mention that we recently gave another laptop, the Lenovo ThinkPad T14 Gen 7, a perfect 10/10 score. Learn more here:
https://www.ifixit.com/News/115827/new-thinkpads-score-perfect-10-repairability
